title: OID tree
description: A recursively nested object identifier (OID) tree.

arc.description: A non-negative decimal OID arc, without leading zeroes.

oidMap.description: OID aliases defined under this node. Each property name is the exported OID key; each value is the final numeric arc below the current node.

additionalProperties.description: Final numeric arc for this exported OID alias, relative to the containing node.

children.description: Nested OID tree nodes below this node. Each property groups a semantic namespace or branch.

rootNode.description: Top-level OID root node. Root arcs are limited to 0, 1, or 2.

node.description: OID namespace node. The node arc extends the parent path and may contain exported OIDs, child nodes, or both.

nodeBase.description: OID tree node with one numeric arc and optional OID aliases and child namespaces.

arc.description: Single numeric OID arc for this node, relative to the parent node. Do not include dots.

oids.description: Exported OID aliases located directly below this node.

children.description: Nested OID namespace branches below this node.
